starter.label: Ascension Seed
starter.quality_note: Latency-first bootstrap model for proving private local inference and orchestration on Render Free. Limited reasoning depth.

standard.label: Ascension Core 0.5B
standard.quality_note: Stronger instruction-following profile for a 2 GB service.

pro.label: Ascension v6b 1.7B LoRA
pro.quality_note: Qwen3-1.7B base with v6b per-capability/execution LoRA. 100% per-cap, 99.84% execution probe, 5/6 canonical 7/8 receipt. Test only; production replacement not yet approved.

pro_proven.label: Ascension proven 1.7B LoRA
pro_proven.quality_note: Qwen3-1.7B base with proven_parent LoRA. 100% generic canonical and receipt gates, 83% per-cap. Use for safety-first testing.

pro_base.label: Ascension Live 1.7B
pro_base.quality_note: Primary latency-bounded profile for multilingual conversation, planning, structured cognition, and tool selection on the 4 GB Pro service.

candidate.label: Ascension Candidate 3B
candidate.quality_note: Controlled benchmark profile for evaluating stronger natural conversation and instruction following without the long hidden-reasoning latency of the 4B Qwen3 worker.

deep.label: Ascension Deep 4B
deep.quality_note: Memory-bounded deeper-reasoning worker for queued research, synthesis, evaluation, and apprenticeship distillation where interactive latency is not required.
